title: hotfix: slo-enforcer backoff tuning and regional failover stabilization under thrashing
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: during a high-traffic incident on 2026-02-19 the SLO enforcer entered a pathological thrashing state during regional failover. Rapid region-level failovers combined with an unbounded exponential backoff and aggressive load-shedding caused longer degradation and cascading circuit-breaker reopenings. This hotfix caps backoff, smooths jitter, and coordinates cooldowns across regions to prevent repeated failovers from oscillating. Changes: 1) cap per-request exponential backoff to 30s, add minimum backoff floor of 50ms; 2) replace pure exponential jitter with smoothed jitter to avoid synchronized retry storms; 3) introduce a cross-region cooldown token in the circuit-breaker coordinator so a failover in one region pauses immediate failovers in peer regions for 90s; 4) add a rate-limited failover retry path and increase health-check grace window during ongoing failover; 5) add feature flags and runtime knobs for emergency rollback and tuning; 6) update related alerting and runbooks. Testing & rollout: unit + integration tests updated; canary rollout to us-west-2 (5% traffic) for 30 minutes, followed by staged ramp to us-east-1. Observability: new metrics added (slo_enforcer.backoff_ms, slo_enforcer.cross_region_cooldown_active) and dashboards updated. Rollback plan: feature flag off and immediate rollback of canary; config change reverts backoff caps. Links: Linear ENG-1182; incident notes internal/INC-2026-02-19. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added/updated - [x] Integration tests covering cross-region coordinator - [x] Canary rollout plan documented - [x] Observability (alerts/dashboards) updated - [x] Postmortem link will be attached after incident triage
